args.command: python3 -c "import numpy as np; x=np.fromfile('bandnoise.dat',dtype=np.float32)[4096:]; p=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(x[:65536]*np.hanning(min(len(x),65536))))**2; f=np.fft.rfftfreq(min(len(x),65536),1/40000); c=np.cumsum(p)/p.sum(); print(len(x), f[np.searchsorted(c,0.01)], f[np.searchsorted(c,0.99)])"

final_text: I ran the flowgraph for two seconds and analysed bandnoise.dat: most of the noise power lies between about 6000 Hz and 9000 Hz (6 kHz to 9 kHz). The flowgraph is unchanged.
